units.text: I containerised 3 legacy services with Docker and moved them to Kubernetes on AWS, replicating the database in advance. The final cut-over took 20 minutes with no customer-facing errors.
I wrote about 200 automated regression tests with pytest and ran them in GitLab CI on every merge request. Releases moved from monthly to weekly, with no rollbacks in 4 months.

I designed and built a REST API in Python with FastAPI for partner integrations, with versioned endpoints and an OpenAPI specification. Within 3 months, 4 partners had connected with no breaking changes.
